## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      22 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 8 juin 2026 - 18 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _BGS Jason_, 18 sept. 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be functional. Whenever the major UI update rolled out, it’s been riddled with bugs. Whatever you guys did made this app borderline unusable. I assume the technology was offshored and that’s why it turned into what it is now"
            2. _Notcool49_, 17 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Used to be great until they updated the app. Now it’s horrible and just freezes everything and won’t unblock anything. I guess it’s good cause now I can’t look at anything. Never make the mistake of updating!"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13 sept. 2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
